'''Zareen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]] salvager and member of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who tried to steal the [[Black cipher|Umbra encrypter]] from under the nose of both the [[Republic Army]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Artano]]. However, the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Havoc Squad captain]] was able to make a deal with her, promising her credits in return, and Zareen sided with [[Havoc Squad]] in a fight against Artano.
